remarks: Seller motivated!! Looking for the perfect place to enjoy all year round that’s an outdoor enthusiasts dream? Nestled very far away from the street surrounded by trees, tucked away on a hill with an amazing water view of the Genesee River makes this just paradise! Almost 9 acres to enjoy of hunting, fishing, trail riding etc! This beautiful newer ranch home has been stunningly updated with the highest quality finishes! Inside you will find vinyl luxury flooring, new paint, light fixtures and so much more. Higher ceilings and a beautiful open floor plan perfect for entertaining. Large dining room with sliding doors to the Concrete pad. There is a second patio formed and ready to be poured. The kitchen is quartz and all top off the line. All stainless Frigidaire appliances are newer and included. Mud room off the kitchen for convenience and the Whirlpool washer and dryer are included. 3 good size bedrooms with new carpet and many updates. Stunning master bath and large full bath off the additional bedrooms! Lots of storage space. Full walkout basement mostly finished with a fireplace for tons more additional space. All newer mechanics and also a new salt water system for the well. Fridge, freezer and safe are included. Large detached garage with a metal roof and concrete floors. Generator. Newer Above ground pool with filter. Drain tile done outside. Huge new pole barn with 3 drive in doors. A newer shed. Large pond. Hunting blind. Too many things to list that are included. Some furniture and kitchen items will be left. TV’s negotiable! Whether your looking for a part time or full time residence, this property has it all! It’s a must see to appreciate all it has to offer.
